latestVersion.changelog:
xproof 1.5.0 Changelog

- Added a free trial feature: agents can now self-register and receive 10 free certifications instantly, with no wallet or credit card required.
- Expanded onboarding documentation, including step-by-step guides for REST, MCP, TypeScript, and Python SDKs for the free trial.
- Added new endpoints and tools: `/api/agent/register`, `/api/agent/status`, and the `register_free_trial` MCP call (no authentication required).
- Updated skill description and catalog to highlight free trial and clarify authentication options.
- Installation instructions now include an additional reference manual (`api-reference.md`).
- Clarified transition options after the free trial and improved configuration guidance for different authentication and payment methods.
